push.body:

PhogsToffees, take this with you: Heart wins the fifty-fifties.

Keep believing. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 2-0 vs Nonie United | You: 7.5
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.5. Every player's got a few of these. The good ones learn from 'em fast.

THE GOOD
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 2). You were the playmaker, the matchmaker and the good-time maker.
+ A goal against Nonie United, your first since Oct 27. Cool as the other side of the pillow.
+ You and PhogsToffees combined like peanut butter and banana. Underrated and delicious.
+ Relegation match survived: we stayed in Division 3. That's what happens when we pull the same rope.
+ Won your matchup: 7.5 against their best forward's 6.3. Proof you've got another gear.

THE BAD
- 72% passing (18 of 25, down from your usual 80%). Back to basics: Weight matters as much as direction. Firm along the ground beats soft and loopy. I've seen you do harder things.
- Shots 1, down from your usual 4. Next rep: When you've got a clear look inside the box, pull the trigger. Hesitation lets defenders recover.
- Match 7 of the session and your rating had slid from 9.4 early on to 7.5. Honest truth: that cost us.
- 2 tackles won pulled you down 0.1. That's the low-hanging fruit.

Practice plan: Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.

BellyTb1, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: Hope is a plan with its shoes untied. Tie 'em.

One rough patch doesn't define a field. - Coach Lasso

buddskees, a 7.4 is a quiet night. Quiet nights are where we learn to be loud.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at Nonie United's goal. You kept the keeper busier than a one-man band.
+ Relegation match survived: we stayed in Division 3. Moments like that are why we keep showing up.
+ Won your matchup: 7.4 against their best forward's 6.3. That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.
+ Better pass accuracy than any of their humans (77% vs their best 65%). Bottle that and bring it next match.
+ Best missed tackles of your 3 matches this session (1). Nobody hands out trophies for that, so here's my handshake.

THE BAD
- 1 of 3 shots on target. Keep this in your pocket: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide. Practice makes permanent.
- PhogsToffees struggled with shot selection too. Work on it as a pair: cut it back to each other.
- 0.6 down on your average. Tomorrow's a fresh page.
- Lowest key passes on the team: 0 (best was BellyTb1's 3). Training homework: Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 22 (best was BellyTb1's 25). That's the bit that kept us from winning.

Before next match: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.

Hey buddskees, hold onto this one: Every pro was once an amateur who didn't quit.

Keep showing up; the results will too. - Coach Lasso
